newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-SAMPRAS SET FOR AGASSI REMATCH.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SAMPRAS SET FOR AGASSI REMATCH.

text.p: Andre Agassi has an immediate opportunity to avenge Friday's crushing defeat by world number one Pete Sampras in Stuttgart when the two Americans reappear at next week's Paris Open.

The pair are seeded to meet again in the quarter-finals at a tournament which also features world number two Michael Chang, former Paris winners Boris Becker and Goran Ivanisevic and ex-Wimbledon champions Stefan Edberg and Michael Stich.
Edberg and Stich have been drawn against each other in the first round, with the winner facing world number three Thomas Muster.
